name: Venero Capital Advisors
deal_size_note: Contact form segments clients from 'Startup (Revenue sub-$2M)' to 'Later Stage (Revenue $50M+)'; site claims 110+ transactions and '$60bn aggregate deal value' (partners' careers). Range is an estimate.
sector_note: Sell-side-only M&A for founder-led software and tech-enabled services businesses; deals include Neocase to Sopra Steria, LiveHire to Humanforce, WCC Hermes to Amadeus, Apli to iCIMS, Mesh.ai to Netchex
description: International sell-side M&A and capital-raising boutique for founder-led software and tech-enabled services companies, with offices in London, Los Angeles and Berlin.
notes: Companies House: VENERO CAPITAL ADVISORS LIMITED (09631750), registered office Derby; site says the UK entity is registered in England and FCA-regulated and gives a London office (23 Berkeley Square). Site lists LA, London, Berlin with no stated HQ; London used as the UK office. UK headcount not stated (team page has 13 names without locations).

name: DC Dwek Corporate Finance
sector_note: Focus on TMT, water and renewable energy, fintech/agtech and real estate; most recent posted deal: sale of a US/Australian oil recycling business (2024)
description: FCA-authorised London corporate finance firm led by ex-UBS banker David Dwek, advising on M&A, MBOs, fundraising and restructuring, often cross-border.
notes: Companies House: DC DWEK CORPORATE FINANCE LIMITED (04298345). Effectively a one-principal firm (Management page lists David Dwek only); credentials list includes his earlier UBS-era deals. Last news item on site is 2024.

name: Mystic Capital Advisors
deal_size_note: Claims 1,000+ transactions over 25 years; published deals are mainly US insurance agency/MGA sales. Range is an estimate.
sector_note: Insurance specialist: retail and specialty insurance brokers, agencies, MGAs and carriers
description: US insurance-sector investment bank (M&A, valuations, due diligence, capital raising) with a London subsidiary, Mystic Capital Advisors Limited, at 1 Cornhill.
notes: Companies House: MYSTIC CAPITAL ADVISORS LIMITED (09054134), registered post town Oxted; site lists it as the group's London-based subsidiary (director Andrew Bathurst, ex-Argenta Syndicate Management CEO). UK team appears to be one director; most published deals are US.

name: Trevally Capital Advisers
deal_size_note: Construction M&A team: 'transactions typically in the £10 million to £500 million range'
sector_note: Specialist construction-sector M&A team (architecture/engineering consultancy, M&E contracting, building products, FM); deals include Egis acquisitions (WME, WW+P, SB Architects, Indec, CPMS), Eton Associates/T Clarke plc, Cairngorm Capital/Polyframe. Also UK SME capital solutions in asset-heavy sectors.
description: FCA-authorised London corporate finance boutique (since 1999) with a specialist cross-border construction M&A team plus UK SME fundraising and capital solutions.
notes: Companies House: TREVALLY CAPITAL ADVISERS LTD (04001724), 14 Buckingham Street, London WC2N 6DF (company number shown on the site).

name: Shield Corporate Finance
deal_size_note: 'Shield works with companies with operating profits of £500K>'; 'irrespective of transaction size'
sector_note: Owner-managed business sales incl. many Employee Ownership Trust transitions (Favoured, Alpha Insurance Analysts, Redbox Fire Control, R&A Fabrications, Doulos) and a Rootwave divestment; also pre-sale value-building programmes
description: Owner-focused sell-side M&A firm founded in 2001 by Dr David Young, preparing and selling UK SMEs (often to Employee Ownership Trusts), with offices in Bournemouth and Edinburgh and representation in New York and Asia.
notes: Companies House: SHIELD CORPORATE FINANCE LTD. (03708848), registered post town Dorchester. Lead website shieldcf.com is a one-page landing page; the main site is sellingabusinessformore.co.uk (footer '© 2026 Shield Corporate Finance Limited'). HQ taken as the first UK office on the contact page (Bournemouth/Westbourne); credentials page also mentions London and Poole. Team page lists 6 names (incl. operations manager and US-linked staff); UK deal headcount not clear.

name: Plutus Corporate Finance
deal_size_note: 'corporate finance transactions for all sizes of business ... with a particular focus on owner-managed businesses'
sector_note: Banker-led funding adviser: acquisition/MBO funding, asset-based lending, invoice/asset/stock finance, mezzanine and property loans; also project-manages acquisitions, MBOs and business sales
description: Bury-based corporate finance firm run by ex-NatWest banker Mark Jenkinson, mainly raising debt and asset-based funding for owner-managed businesses, including MBO and acquisition funding and business sales.
notes: Companies House: PLUTUS CORPORATE FINANCE LLP (OC315303), registered post town Northwich; contact page gives 2 Heap Bridge, Bury BL9 7HR. Site is an old static site with no dated deals; mainly a funding/debt adviser (borderline with a loan broker). Team size not stated (only the senior partner is named).

name: AMP Capital Advisory
deal_size_note: Founders 'advised on, raised, and structured in excess of $300bn of transactions' in prior bank/law-firm careers; no firm deals published. Range is an estimate.
sector_note: Roots in energy and natural resources (upstream/downstream M&A, reserve-based lending, high yield, equity raises for NOCs, majors and independents); also sovereign restructurings and emerging-market capital markets
description: Senior-led London advisory boutique founded by three ex-investment bank/law firm executives, advising on M&A, capital markets and financing, with roots in energy and natural resources.
notes: Companies House: AMP CAPITAL ADVISORY LIMITED (13575999), registered office Great Titchfield House, London W1W 8BD (as on site); FCA appointed representative of Brooklands Fund Management. Three founders, two with UK phone numbers (one UAE). Large-cap/emerging-markets focus, unlikely SME.
